t: Lineage and birth of the Prophet ﷺ
id:
Nabi Muhammad ﷺ lahir di Makkah pada tahun Gajah dari keluarga Bani Hasyim, suku Quraisy. Beliau sendiri menyebut keutamaan nasab ini: Allah memilih Kinanah dari keturunan Ismail, memilih Quraisy dari Kinanah, memilih Bani Hasyim dari Quraisy, dan memilih beliau dari Bani Hasyim.

Ketika ditanya tentang puasa hari Senin, beliau menjawab bahwa itu hari beliau dilahirkan dan hari wahyu diturunkan kepada beliau. Karena itu puasa Senin menjadi sunnah yang beliau jaga.

Pelajaran: kemuliaan nasab tidak membuat beliau sombong. Justru beliau mengisi hari kelahirannya dengan ibadah.
en:
The Prophet Muhammad ﷺ was born in Makkah in the Year of the Elephant, into Banu Hashim of Quraysh. He described this lineage himself: Allah chose Kinanah from the descendants of Isma'il, Quraysh from Kinanah, Banu Hashim from Quraysh, and him from Banu Hashim.

Asked about fasting on Mondays, he said it was the day he was born and the day revelation came to him, so Monday fasting became a sunnah he kept.

Lesson: a noble lineage did not make him proud; he marked his birthday with worship.
